text: Program Description Course Introduction 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program is open to international students intending to pursue the science and practice of medicine. Aims to nurture high-caliber medical graduates with solid medical knowledge, competent clinical skills, and professionalism. Have the ability to work in medical and health institutions. Make meaningful contributions to the areas of patient care, education, and research. Emphasis on technical skills, interdisciplinary studies, and clinical practice. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: There are three main categories -- as well as 16 main courses for the program. Curriculum (for reference only) Course Categories Course Chinese Culture & Natural Science Courses Brief Introduction to China Chinese Language Medical Chinese Mathematics Physics Chemistry Biological Sciences Computers Organic Chemistry Liberal Arts & Basic Medicine Courses Histoembryology Anatomy Cell Biology Genetics Physiology Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Immunology Microbiology Parasitology Pathophysiology Pathology Medical Ethics Pharmacology Clinical Medicine Courses Diagnostics Diagnostic Imaging Medicine Surgery Obstetrics and Gynecology Pediatrics Preventive Medicine Epidemiology Medical Psychology Psychiatry Neurology Dermatology Oncology Ophthalmology Otolaryngology Stomatology Forensic Medicine Traditional Chinese Medicine 3. Internship Information Editor Notes: Students will have the opportunity to participate in overseas clinical internship programs. The internship starts in the last 1 year. 11 affiliated hospitals, of which eight are level three first-class hospitals.. Have the opportunity to participate in overseas clinical internship programs. The tuition for the internship year is still RMB 75,000/year. 4. Degree Awarded You'll be shown how the MBBS Degree is awarded and what you should do after obtaining your MBBS degree MBBS Degree Awarded: After completing the required number of credits, students will be conferred a diploma from Fudan University, and qualified students will receive a degree of Bachelor of Medicine and the Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS). After Obtaining MBBS Degree: Graduates will have the opportunity to register for medical licensing exams in accordance with the requirements of the relevant regulatory bodies of the countries in which they choose to practice. School Introduction 5. Brief Introduction to Fudan University Fudan University was established in 1905 as Fudan Public School. As one of the first participants in the 211 and 985 Projects, Fudan has developed into a comprehensive research university, with Departments of Philosophy, Economics, Law, Education, Literature, History, Science, Engineering, Medicine, and Management. After years of exploring and practicing, Fudan has now established its own curriculum and management system, both of which are unique and progressively improving. Learn More about Fudan University 6. About International Students Office(ISO) Take the charge of management and coordination of admission for international degree and non-degree students. Be responsibale for visa processing, residence permit application, insurance affairs. The duty of ISO is researching and drafting management policies regarding international students, management of the International Students Dormitory.
